claim_ceiling: A summary-level PIV quality and cross-diagnostic comparison reference. It does not process raw PIV images, estimate velocity uncertainty from images, or validate physical EHD thrust. All benchmark thresholds are prospective unless explicitly identified as published comparator results.

caveats: The stratified random vector-level test split is not a geometry/session holdout.
Expert manual labels are a processing reference, not independent physical velocity truth.
High F1 does not establish calibrated per-vector velocity uncertainty.
The weak 0.62 subtle-noise and 0.68 MHD cases are important domain-transfer challenges.
The reported external 6-dataset evaluation is stronger than a random vector split but still requires detailed cohort matching before direct EHD claims.

research_baselines.role: matched uncertainty-estimation comparators; exact algorithms and parameters must be frozen per benchmark
research_baselines.caveat: Do not compare only vector validity classification when the task is velocity-uncertainty estimation.

research_baselines.role: EHD-specific cross-check: planar PIV near-wall velocity and integral momentum versus four-pulse Shake-the-Box LPT material acceleration and differential momentum
caveats: The source is a conference abstract, not a raw-data uncertainty package.
PIV/LPT velocity agreement is not independent if they share images, particles, seeding, illumination or calibration.
The differential momentum path still requires pressure gradient, density, viscous/body forces and uncertainty.

classifier_contract.principle: report false removal of reference-valid vectors separately; an apparently good F1 must not hide destructive filtering of real near-wall/shear/wake structures
classifier_contract.comparison_reporting: Report both valid-class and invalid-class precision/recall/F1, macro-F1, balanced accuracy and MCC. Align the published comparator's positive-class convention and confusion matrix before making direct F1 comparisons.

uncertainty_contract.policy: report each region separately; no pooled-only pass
uncertainty_contract.principle: F1/classifier labels do not substitute for calibrated velocity uncertainty

cross_diagnostic_contract.uncertainty_policy: sum absolute componentwise bounds; do not RSS-combine without validated covariance
cross_diagnostic_contract.passivity: observer perturbation remains NotAssessed until EHD-DPM-001 receipt passes
cross_diagnostic_contract.force_triangulation: compare all-surface PIV momentum, LPT material-acceleration/differential momentum and direct load cell only after each estimator's complete physical boundary and uncertainty are qualified

manufactured_examples.shared_acquisition_example: PIV and LPT estimates share acquisition_id; receipt marks the comparison as shared-acquisition algorithm cross-check, not independent cross-validation

probability_score_contract.probability_semantics: predicted probability that a vector is invalid
probability_score_contract.reporting: overall and independently by bulk, near_wall, shear_layer and wake
probability_score_contract.numerical_policy: clip exact 0/1 probabilities to [1e-15,1-1e-15] for finite log loss; preserve raw probabilities for Brier/reliability
probability_score_contract.missing_class_policy: ROC-AUC is null for a one-class cohort; no fabricated zero
probability_score_contract.comparison_policy: compare probabilities only on the same labels and frozen holdout cohort; report threshold-free probability metrics before thresholded class metrics
probability_score_contract.note: ECE is binning-dependent and is not a proper scoring rule

external_baseline_convention.PIVPostProcess_2026: paper defines predicted probability as P(valid vector)
external_baseline_convention.invariance: ROC-AUC, log loss and Brier score remain invariant when labels and probabilities are complemented together

PIVPostProcess_2026.scope: Source-reported target for exact matched cohort and labels only; not a generic result or current Luminous result.
